header: PICTURES FOR THE STORIES OF A PAPER THAT DOES NOT LET ITS PAGES BE READ. Anandabazar Patrika and The Telegraph refuse every automated request (403, even for robots.txt), so I cannot take the picture from their story pages, and I do not work around a refusal. Their stories reach the cards through Google News, whose feed has no pictures. Bing News holds the same stories WITH a picture (its own thumbnail, which it will size to what is asked): I ask it about each of those papers and give a story the picture of the Bing item that is the same story, when there is one. Bing's index is some hours behind Google's, so the newest stories often have no match yet (measured 28 Nov 2026: Bing held 7 of the newest 20 Anandabazar stories and 46 of 279 over two days): a story with no match shows its tile. Bing is used for the PICTURES only: its items are never shown as stories, so its delay costs the lists nothing.

symbols.name: bingPictureOf
doc: The picture of one item of Bing's feed (its <News:Image>), asked of Bing at 720 x 480 (3:2), over https and only on Bing's own host; "" when it has none.

symbols.name: parseBingPictures
doc: The headline and the picture of each item of Bing's feed.

symbols.name: sameHeadline
symbols.sig: export function sameHeadline(a: string, b: string): boolean
doc: Is the hint the SAME headline: the picture of one story must never be put on another (the owner wants a picture that is 100% relevant or none). So this is strict: the same words (one headline the beginning of the other, because Bing cuts a long headline with "..."), or at least four words in which 85% of the shorter headline's words are shared and the figures do not disagree. Two stories of one company or one sector ("SAIL vs Jindal Steel: stocks compared", "Tata Steel, JSW, SAIL: fresh targets") are NOT the same.

symbols.name: bingHeadlineSearch
doc: Bing News' search for one headline (its first nine words, the paper's name taken off), in India's edition.

symbols.name: FOUND
symbols.sig: const FOUND = new Map<string, { image: string | null; at: number }>()

symbols.name: keepFor
doc: A picture found is kept a day; "none found" only twenty minutes, because Bing's index is some hours behind the papers and may have the story later.

symbols.name: pictureFound
symbols.sig: export function pictureFound(title: string, now = Date.now()): string | null | undefined
doc: What the picture search of this headline gave before (undefined: not asked, or the answer is old).

symbols.name: pictureByHeadline
symbols.sig: export async function pictureByHeadline(title: string, getText: (url: string) => Promise<string | null>): Promise<string | null>
doc: A SECOND SOURCE FOR A PICTURE: when a story's own paper gives none (its page refuses or has none), Bing News is asked for that headline, and the picture of the item that is the SAME headline (sameHeadline) is taken; none that is the same: none (the story is then not shown). `getText` is the reader of an address (null when it fails: then nothing is kept, so that it is asked again).

symbols.name: attachPictures
symbols.sig: export function attachPictures<T extends FeedItem>(items: T[], hints: PictureHint[]): T[]
doc: Gives each story that has no picture the picture of the hint that is the same story (the first, Bing's order); a story that has one is left as it is.
